limitations: Current-survivor proxy universe; not a point-in-time ETF universe.
Yahoo auto-adjusted prices are a total-return proxy, not issuer NAV authority.
Macro and event snapshots are prospective context only; holdings, futures-curve, FX and tax inputs are absent.

methodology.curve: month-end historical observations in the same 10-point opportunity-score band
methodology.downside_risk: positioning-unwind watch requires prior 58-session gain >=15%, 5-session loss >=6%, relative loss versus SPY >=4%, and 21-session drawdown >=9%; only a material negative event upgrades it to downside bias
methodology.final_score: price score plus bounded fresh catalysts, decaying persistent sentiment, historical analogs, risk, and state-transition inputs; repeated coverage cannot multiply one theme
methodology.opportunity: 75% cross-sectional 21/63/126-session total-return momentum rank + 25% positive-trend confirmation
methodology.risk: equal-weight cross-sectional 63-session volatility and 126-session drawdown ranks

DEFENSE_ORDERS.rationale: Verified procurement/defense-policy state changes: $2.1bn Patriot sale to Ukraine (corroborated by FY26 budget), Senate defense bill, Havelsan-Nigeria deal, US-Europe defense burden shift, FORTRESS basing, DPRK weapons test, Indra guidance, and Iran nuclear-ban debate.

ECONOMIC_GROWTH.rationale: Macro prints: euro-area unemployment, US GDP growth, China PMI contraction, Hungary GDP/IMF forecast, US debt/GDP, Brazil record-low unemployment, and Norway unemployment/OECD slowdown.

ENERGY_SUPPLY.rationale: Distinct supply-side events: Iran tanker ban (Hormuz risk), OPEC+ steady output and UAE exit, QatarEnergy LNG force majeure extension, Eni Libya/Indonesia gas starts, Africa Energy Bank launch, Big Oil windfall, and price reaction on peace hopes.

FINANCIAL_STRESS.rationale: No distinct verified financial-stress events; supplied reports are local food-bank strain, a bank rating affirmation, and a marathon.

HEALTH_POLICY.rationale: Policy actions with market relevance: NC Medicaid expansion, Medicare drug premium surge/plan narrowing, Medicaid work-requirement court ruling, FDA accelerated approval (INOVIO), FDA ketamine approval, EU-Canada medical countermeasures pact, EMA PRAC outcomes, and cancer-drug price cuts.

MILITARY_GEOPOLITICS.rationale: Verified state changes with material global transmission: Houthi missile strikes and US diplomatic drawdown in Saudi Arabia (oil chokepoint transmission), Oleshky ceasefire (energy/security), Iranian retaliation posture (oil risk), and $15bn US base damage. Secondary items cover Black Sea escalation, China drone capability, and DPRK sanctions pushback.

MONETARY_INFLATION.rationale: Central-bank state changes and inflation prints: BoC hike, BOJ hold at target, Lagarde resignation, Fed hike signals, Kenya inflation, Norway stability warning/rate hold, Colombia FX purchase, and broader rate-hike expectations.

POLITICAL_SOCIAL_SHOCK.rationale: Distinct shocks with material relevance: Bolivia El Niño emergency, Japan earthquake toll, Afghanistan quake, Canadian wildfire smoke disrupting NY, Colorado flood disaster declarations, Phuket/Kauai floods, Brazil election dispute, and wildfire-prevention power cuts.

PRECIOUS_METALS.rationale: Gold market state changes: 10-month low global sell-off (multi-country corroboration), Fed-signal slip, surging gold loans, India gold-import curb call, Alamos production outlook, smuggling case, record nugget find, and short-interest shift.

TECHNOLOGY_AI.rationale: Material AI/semi events: Intel rout, Samsung record profit, Korea chip export surge, Bain $6T AI revenue gap, Quad supply-risk mapping, SK hynix Japan supply chain, data-center carbon/backlash, and Marvell-Lumentum optical M&A chatter.

TRADE_CONTROLS.rationale: Verified policy actions: China AI/biopharma export controls, US Section 338 revisions, Canada's 100% China EV tariff, robotics trade review, Vietnam tariff/tax moves, Namibia zero-tariff access, UK-Scotch tariff dispute, and China trade surplus data.
